name: Entire
summary: Git forge for agent-human collaboration with Trails, continuous memory and agent session storage.
description: Entire, led by former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke, is a distributed Git-compatible forge built for agentic coding. It replaces pull requests with Trails (agent-scored evals), stores agent sessions/prompts with commits as Continuous Memory, and offers agentic search across code and sessions. Positioned for high-throughput agent push/clone workloads. Public pricing was not published on the homepage during verification, so pricing is left blank.
features: Trails with agent-scored evals instead of pull requests
Continuous Memory storing agent sessions and prompts with commits
Agentic search across code and sessions
